name: Blockyard Paper
author: accounts@playblockyard.com
description: Reviewed Minecraft installer; fails if the selected version is unavailable. EULA acceptance is separate.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
USER_AGENT='Blockyard/0.1 (Minecraft hosting)'
BASE="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/paper/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --user-agent "$USER_AGENT" "$BASE" -o version.json
if [ "$BUILD_NUMBER" = latest ]; then BUILD_NUMBER=$(jq -er '.builds[0]' version.json); fi
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --user-agent "$USER_AGENT" "$BASE/builds/$BUILD_NUMBER" -o build.json
DOWNLOAD_URL=$(jq -er '.downloads["server:default"].url' build.json)
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --user-agent "$USER_AGENT" "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o server.jar.part
jar tf server.jar.part >/dev/null
mv server.jar.part server.jar
rm version.json build.json
if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  printf 'server-port=25565\nserver-ip=0.0.0.0\nonline-mode=true\nmotd=PlayBlockyard Minecraft Server\n' > server.properties
fi

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The version of minecraft to download. 

Leave at latest to always get the latest version. Invalid versions will default to latest.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description:
The build number for the paper release.

Leave at latest to always get the latest version. Invalid versions will default to latest.
